text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 100 mm of round tube; square and deburr both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The bore must be 122 mm or more so it slides over a 114 mm pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: four 4.5 mm holes 4 mm down from the top edge, at 45, 135,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 225 and 315 degrees; countersink them for M4 screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom: three 11 mm holes 25 mm up from the bottom edge, at 0, 120

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 240 degrees; set an M8 stainless rivet nut in each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Put the hole at 0 degrees on the road side when fitting.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the cap disc goes inside the top, flush, on the four radial

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws; the sleeve then sits on the pole top through the disc.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three M8 cup-point set screws in the rivet nuts centre it on the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it slides over a 114 mm tube with 3 to 4 mm all round.
